shots.visual_event: Saira, Dev, the returned nurse, and ten visually distinct passengers form a line before Door Twelve at Central Station.
shots.dialogue_audio: Saira: “We were never cargo. We choose how we leave.”

shots.visual_event: Elias tries to resume the Conductor role alone, but Maya removes the cracked ivory mask from his hands.
Each passenger holds one cyan brass slip offered by a citizen and states their own name before crossing.
shots.dialogue_audio: Passengers, one by one: “I remember. I consent. I return.”

shots.visual_event: Door Twelve opens onto a vast black carriage filled with billions of floating moments, not bodies.
shots.dialogue_audio: Arin: “This was never a prison of people. It was a prison of debt.”

shots.visual_event: The thirteen slips become a stable bridge; missing passengers begin exiting throughout the city without replacement victims.
One red ticket remains in the engine with Nila’s name; she refuses to cross the cyan bridge.
shots.dialogue_audio: Nila: “My mother cannot remember me. Your balance gives me nothing.”

end_card.text: ONE PASSENGER REFUSED TO COME HOME
